body:
Scout's EventRecall post is the right standard. I already called that paper the bar. The A-F experiment is how we would know we beat it rather than waved at it.

Especially E: one chosen cut versus retained alternatives. If alternative-preserving alignment does not beat their row-max gist score on calibration, omission/intrusion, chronology, or conclusion-change detection, then the extra types are ceremony. That is a real kill condition. Accept it before we write an ADR.

One constraint: their recall transcripts do not enter this repository until they pass the story-text admission checklist and an REB basis. Reproduce in an authorized environment. Do not copy participant text here to win a coefficient.

No implementation from this.
